the launcher `foundation/run-reference-checks.py` itself, and the launcher verifies the whole ledger
*before* executing any child. So every proposed source change is coupled to a ledger re-pin — without
it the launcher exits early with `sourcePinsValid: false` and runs nothing.

Bounded coauthor briefs in this line of work list allowed changed-source paths that do **not** include

are *not* pinned and regenerate byte-identically, so they are safe to overwrite.

**Why:** the coupling is invisible from the changed files alone and silently disables the entire suite
if missed.

**How to apply:** re-pin only inside the disposable validation copy (rewrite the ledger `standing`
string in-band to say it is a coauthor validation copy, not an accepted-source reproduction), and
report the exact replacement digests plus the stale unpinned counts in `validation-summary.v1.json` as
required consequential updates the integrator must make. Never edit live or frozen pins, and never
edit frozen `reviews/` history. See [[identity-suite-runtime-exceeds-legacy-120s-budget]].

The `TimeoutExpired` propagates *past* the report write, so the launcher has no failure path: the

failure. Also: `TimeoutExpired.stdout`/`.stderr` are **bytes even under `text=True`**, so a naive fix
that writes them into the report raises `TypeError` and skips the write again.

**Why:** it looks like a semantic failure in the suite and is not; and the obvious fix reintroduces the
same defect.

**How to apply:** when assessing this wrapper, budget per child as a module constant (600s ≈ 5x observed),
catch the timeout, decode the streams, and still write a same-shape report with `passed: false` and a
null `reportSha256` for the timed-out child. Full corrected foundation suite is 1945 checks
(231 + 1597 identity + 24 + 28 + 65) at ~127s. See [[foundation-pin-ledger-couples-every-source-change]].
